detailCrop.purpose: Resolve the multiplication dot and two outward dimension arrowheads.

observation.coordinateConvention: Original raster pixels [column,row], top-left origin. Landmarks are observed stroke-center estimates, not calibrated physical coordinates; nominal uncertainty 8 pixels, larger at the merged origin/axis strokes.
observation.reason: Neither current edition prose nor exercises queries a numbered graph coordinate. The source has no numerical scale or units.

horizontal.meaning: position along the string, not time

curves.label: t
curves.role: earlier waveform through O; positive slope at O

curves.label: t + Δt
curves.role: later waveform translated right, below equilibrium at s=0; does not pass through O

dimensions.label: λ
dimensions.relation: The first and second crests of the earlier curve are nearest same-phase maxima, one wavelength apart.

dimensions.label: Δs = v·Δt
dimensions.relation: The later third crest is right of the earlier third crest by Δs = v·Δt; no numerical value for Δs or Δt.

velocity.label: v
velocity.relation: The waveform propagates toward increasing s; the small arrow above v is a vector accent, not a second process arrow.

sourceFacts: One unnumbered displacement-versus-position frame, two solid curves and eight symbolic labels.
Both curves occupy the same finite plotted interval; the later curve is shifted right, not a different-amplitude wave.
The earlier curve crosses O rising; the later curve has negative displacement at s=0.
Each curve has three crests and two troughs in view; five inter-curve crossings alternate positive and negative.
The wavelength dimension joins the first two earlier crests; the shift dimension joins the third earlier and later crests.
The t leader points up/right to the earlier descending branch; the t + Δt leader points up/left to the later ascending branch.
All wave strokes are solid. There are no numbered ticks, physical units, grid, answer labels, amplitude formula, or period fraction.
The source multiplication mark is a middle dot; the origin is capital O, not numeral zero.

regularization.renderCoordinateUnit: Uncalibrated schematic unit, not a supplied physical value.
regularization.justification: Rectify scan skew and make the explicitly described equal-amplitude harmonic translation exact. Period 350 follows the first-to-second crest pixel separation; shift 60 follows the first crest pair. Later intervals and shift differ by a few scan pixels. None of these schematic numbers is drawn, and the ratios are not claimed as given numerical data.
regularization.endpointPolicy: Both curves stop at the observed source right-edge column 965 mapped to s=915; no extension beyond their source domain.
regularization.nativePolicy: Sample after recording defining anchors; include every zero, extremum, curve intersection and leader attachment explicitly, then connect using native JSXGraph segments.
modernAdditions: Rectified continuous axes replace the slightly tilted scan and its small horizontal scan gap.
Invisible-size native anchor dots and sampled connecting segments enable executable relationships; no visible point dots are introduced.
Expanded vertical composition and 640px scroll media keep all symbolic labels at least 16px.
Literal mathematical glyphs and the vector-accent arrow are preserved with renderer-owned vector text and native arrows.
forbiddenAdditions: inferred numeric time or phase difference
